knowledge_tier_count_dtype: uint16, exact for this immutable public tier
formula_definition: RDKit CalcMolFormula defaults: separateIsotopes=False, charge included; exact text equality
formula_reuse: Retained knowledge counts use the same 105875489-row tier. Every previously unseen formula is resolved by exact formula matches in mass windows; non-neutral and unsupported-element formulas have no eligible tier rows.
np_score_credit: Ertl, Roggo and Schuffenhauer, J Chem Inf Model 48, 68-74 (2008), DOI 10.1021/ci700286x; RDKit Contrib open-data model
missing_value_rules: Invalid sanitized structures retain row position and null chemistry descriptors and scaffolds; valid acyclic scaffolds are empty strings. Formula ambiguity still uses stored formula. A failed scaffold transformation on an otherwise valid molecule produces null only for the undefined scaffold and is listed explicitly; rdkit_valid still describes source sanitization.
